message.content: Why does the owl sanctuary booking API double-charge when two keepers reserve the same perch at once?

content.text: The reservation handler reads perch availability and writes the charge in separate transactions, so two concurrent requests both see the perch free. Wrap both in one transaction with SELECT FOR UPDATE.
